summary: @onereach/content-builder ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, bun-v1.3.13) and invokes it against a shipped 727KB sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled CJS bundle (marker `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with string-array rotation obfuscation (`WV8StW` rotator, encoded charset table) and has no functional relationship to the package's advertised Slack/Teams content-conversion purpose. Fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime solely to execute an opaque, obfuscated bundle at install time causes attacker-selected code to run on the installer's host during `npm install`, and evades Node-based static analysis of the executed payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
